title: Maze arcade / 迷宮吃豆遊戲
description: Complete offline single HTML Pac-Man-style maze game. Four ghosts, connected maze, pellets and power pellets, score, three lives, chase/flee, win/loss, restart/pause, keyboard WASD/arrows, touch/swipe, fullscreen. Deterministic advanceTime and render_game_to_text; emits game-score for optional scoreboard. 可複製完整 HTML 再修改。
usage: Copy index.html to your chosen output filename. No network or build required. Optional scoreboard.js can be loaded after the game script; Scoreboard.attach({selector:"main", key:"maze-scores"}) listens to game-score.
verification: Chromium fixture acceptance 2026-10-02: controls/persistence/offline and canonical game captures exercised. Full-board wins and physical Safari unverified. Fixture evidence is not future model-delivery evidence.
